title: Luke's visit down the Osiris shaft

tellings.quote: I was with Land of Kim and he showed me if you're familiar with him. And um so you go down in the Osiris shaft and it drops down.

plain: A pyramid researcher named Luke Caverns says he went down the Osiris shaft, a deep underground passage beneath the causeway at the Giza pyramids in Egypt, where, as he puts it, "it drops down." He tells it as his own visit, made with a guide who goes by the name Land of Kem and showed him around. He brings it up as part of his case that the pyramids are not what people think.
